subject: Mathematics
description: Mathematics concept progression map — Foundation to Year 10. Seven strands for visualisation purposes: Number Concepts, Number Modelling, Algebra, Measurement, Space, Statistics, Probability. Year-level concept dependency chains.

standards.title: Numbers to 120
standards.description: Recognise, represent and order numbers to at least 120 using physical and virtual materials, numerals, number lines and charts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise, represent and order numbers to at least 120.

standards.title: Partition two-digit numbers
standards.description: Partition one- and two-digit numbers in different ways using physical and virtual materials, including partitioning two-digit numbers into tens and ones
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students partition one- and two-digit numbers including into tens and ones.

standards.title: Quantify sets by skip counting
standards.description: Quantify sets of objects, to at least 120, by partitioning collections into equal groups using number knowledge and skip counting
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students quantify sets to at least 120 using equal groups and skip counting.

standards.title: Add and subtract within 20
standards.description: Add and subtract numbers within 20, using physical and virtual materials, part-part-whole knowledge to 10 and a variety of calculation strategies
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students add and subtract numbers within 20 using part-part-whole knowledge and strategies.

standards.title: Model additive problems
standards.description: Use mathematical modelling to solve practical problems involving additive situations including simple money transactions; represent the situations with diagrams, physical and virtual materials, and use calculation strategies to solve the problem
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use mathematical modelling to solve practical additive problems including simple money.

standards.title: Model sharing and grouping
standards.description: Use mathematical modelling to solve practical problems involving equal sharing and grouping; represent the situations with diagrams, physical and virtual materials, and use calculation strategies to solve the problem
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use mathematical modelling to solve practical problems involving equal sharing and grouping.

standards.title: Skip counting patterns
standards.description: Recognise, continue and create pattern sequences, with numbers, symbols, shapes and objects, formed by skip counting, initially by twos, fives and tens
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise, continue and create skip counting patterns by twos, fives and tens.

standards.title: Repeating patterns
standards.description: Recognise, continue and create repeating patterns with numbers, symbols, shapes and objects, identifying the repeating unit
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise, continue and create repeating patterns, identifying the repeating unit.

standards.title: Order by length, mass, capacity
standards.description: Compare directly and indirectly and order objects and events using attributes of length, mass, capacity and duration, communicating reasoning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students compare and order objects and events by length, mass, capacity and duration.

standards.title: Measure length with informal units
standards.description: Measure the length of shapes and objects using informal units, recognising that units need to be uniform and used end-to-end
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students measure length using uniform informal units placed end-to-end.

standards.title: Duration and sequence of events
standards.description: Describe the duration and sequence of events using years, months, weeks, days and hours
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students describe duration and sequence of events using years, months, weeks, days and hours.

standards.title: Compare and classify shapes
standards.description: Make, compare and classify familiar shapes; recognise familiar shapes and objects in the environment, identifying the similarities and differences between them
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students make, compare and classify familiar shapes and recognise them in the environment.

standards.title: Give and follow directions
standards.description: Give and follow directions to move people and objects to different locations within a space
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students give and follow directions to move people and objects within a space.

standards.title: Acquire and record categorical data
standards.description: Acquire and record data for categorical variables in various ways including using digital tools, objects, images, drawings, lists, tally marks and symbols
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students acquire and record data for categorical variables using various representations.

standards.title: Represent and compare data
standards.description: Represent collected data for a categorical variable using one-to-one displays and digital tools where appropriate; compare the data using frequencies and discuss the findings
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students represent categorical data using one-to-one displays and compare using frequencies.

standards.title: Numbers to 1000
standards.description: Recognise, represent and order numbers to at least 1000 using physical and virtual materials, numerals and number lines
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise, represent and order numbers to at least 1000.

standards.title: Partition three-digit numbers
standards.description: Partition, rearrange, regroup and rename two- and three-digit numbers using standard and non-standard groupings; recognise the role of a zero digit in place value notation
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students partition, rearrange and rename two- and three-digit numbers, recognising the role of zero.

standards.title: Halves, quarters and eighths
standards.description: Recognise and describe one-half as one of 2 equal parts of a whole and connect halves, quarters and eighths through repeated halving
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise halves, quarters and eighths through repeated halving.

standards.title: Add and subtract two-digit numbers
standards.description: Add and subtract one- and two-digit numbers, representing problems using number sentences, and solve using part-part-whole reasoning and a variety of calculation strategies
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students add and subtract one- and two-digit numbers using part-part-whole reasoning.

standards.title: Multiply and divide with strategies
standards.description: Multiply and divide by one-digit numbers using repeated addition, equal grouping, arrays, and partitioning to support a variety of calculation strategies
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students multiply and divide using repeated addition, arrays and partitioning.

standards.title: Model additive and multiplicative problems
standards.description: Use mathematical modelling to solve practical problems involving additive and multiplicative situations, including money transactions; represent situations and choose calculation strategies; interpret and communicate solutions in terms of the situation
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use mathematical modelling to solve additive and multiplicative problems including money.

standards.title: Additive patterns
standards.description: Recognise, describe and create additive patterns that increase or decrease by a constant amount, using numbers, shapes and objects, and identify missing elements in the pattern
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise, describe and create additive patterns that increase or decrease by a constant amount.

standards.title: Addition facts to 20
standards.description: Recall and demonstrate proficiency with addition facts to 20; extend and apply facts to develop related subtraction facts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recall addition facts to 20 and apply to develop related subtraction facts.

standards.title: Multiplication facts for twos
standards.description: Recall and demonstrate proficiency with multiplication facts for twos; extend and apply facts to develop the related division facts using doubling and halving
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recall multiplication facts for twos and apply to develop division facts.

standards.title: Measure with informal units
standards.description: Measure and compare objects based on length, capacity and mass using appropriate uniform informal units and smaller units for accuracy when necessary
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students measure and compare length, capacity and mass using uniform informal units.

standards.title: Halves, quarters, eighths in context
standards.description: Identify common uses and represent halves, quarters and eighths in relation to shapes, objects and events
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify and represent halves, quarters and eighths in relation to shapes, objects and events.

standards.title: Use calendars
standards.description: Identify the date and determine the number of days between events using calendars
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use calendars to identify dates and determine days between events.

standards.title: Read analog clock
standards.description: Recognise and read the time represented on an analog clock to the hour, half-hour and quarter-hour
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students read analog clocks to the hour, half-hour and quarter-hour.

standards.title: Measures of turn
standards.description: Identify, describe and demonstrate quarter, half, three-quarter and full measures of turn in everyday situations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify and demonstrate quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns.

standards.title: Classify shapes by sides
standards.description: Recognise, compare and classify shapes, referencing the number of sides and using spatial terms such as 'opposite', 'parallel', 'curved' and 'straight'
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students compare and classify shapes by number of sides and spatial properties.

standards.title: Locate positions in 2D space
standards.description: Locate positions in two-dimensional representations of a familiar space; move positions by following directions and pathways
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students locate positions in 2D representations and follow directions and pathways.

standards.title: Acquire and sort categorical data
standards.description: Acquire data for categorical variables through surveys, observation, experiment and using digital tools; sort data into relevant categories and display data using lists and tables
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students acquire and sort categorical data and display using lists and tables.

standards.title: Compare graphical representations
standards.description: Create different graphical representations of data using software where appropriate; compare the different representations, identify and describe common and distinctive features in response to questions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students create and compare different graphical representations of data.

standards.title: Numbers beyond 10 000
standards.description: Recognise, represent and order natural numbers using naming and writing conventions for numerals beyond 10 000
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise, represent and order natural numbers beyond 10 000.

standards.title: Unit fractions and multiples
standards.description: Recognise and represent unit fractions including 1/2, 1/3, 1/4, 1/5 and 1/10 and their multiples in different ways; combine fractions with the same denominator to complete the whole
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise unit fractions and their multiples and combine fractions with the same denominator.

standards.title: Add and subtract three-digit numbers
standards.description: Add and subtract two- and three-digit numbers using place value to partition, rearrange and regroup numbers to assist in calculations without a calculator
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students add and subtract two- and three-digit numbers using place value partitioning.

standards.title: Multiply and divide with strategies
standards.description: Multiply and divide one- and two-digit numbers, representing problems using number sentences, diagrams and arrays, and using a variety of calculation strategies
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students multiply and divide one- and two-digit numbers using number sentences, diagrams and arrays.

standards.title: Estimate quantities
standards.description: Estimate the quantity of objects in collections and make estimates when solving problems to determine the reasonableness of calculations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students estimate quantities and use estimation to check reasonableness of calculations.

standards.title: Model additive and multiplicative problems
standards.description: Use mathematical modelling to solve practical problems involving additive and multiplicative situations including financial contexts; formulate problems using number sentences and choose calculation strategies, using digital tools where appropriate; interpret and communicate solutions in terms of the situation
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use mathematical modelling to solve additive and multiplicative problems including financial contexts.

standards.title: Algorithms to investigate numbers
standards.description: Follow and create algorithms involving a sequence of steps and decisions to investigate numbers; describe any emerging patterns
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students follow and create algorithms to investigate numbers and describe emerging patterns.

standards.title: Addition and subtraction as inverses
standards.description: Recognise and explain the connection between addition and subtraction as inverse operations, apply to partition numbers and find unknown values in number sentences
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise addition and subtraction as inverses and find unknown values in number sentences.

standards.title: Mental strategies for larger numbers
standards.description: Extend and apply knowledge of addition and subtraction facts to 20 to develop efficient mental strategies for computation with larger numbers without a calculator
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students apply addition and subtraction facts to develop efficient mental computation strategies.

standards.title: Multiplication facts 3, 4, 5, 10
standards.description: Recall and demonstrate proficiency with multiplication facts for 3, 4, 5 and 10; extend and apply facts to develop the related division facts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recall multiplication facts for 3, 4, 5 and 10 and apply to develop division facts.

standards.title: Identify metric units
standards.description: Identify which metric units are used to measure everyday items; use measurements of familiar items and known units to make estimates
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify metric units for everyday items and use them to make estimates.

standards.title: Measure with metric units
standards.description: Measure and compare objects using familiar metric units of length, mass and capacity, and instruments with labelled markings
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students measure and compare objects using familiar metric units of length, mass and capacity.

standards.title: Units of time
standards.description: Recognise and use the relationship between formal units of time including days, hours, minutes and seconds to estimate and compare the duration of events
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use relationships between days, hours, minutes and seconds to estimate and compare duration.

standards.title: Read clocks to the minute
standards.description: Describe the relationship between the hours and minutes on analog and digital clocks, and read the time to the nearest minute
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students read analog and digital clocks to the nearest minute.

standards.title: Compare angles to right angles
standards.description: Identify angles as measures of turn and compare angles with right angles in everyday situations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify angles as measures of turn and compare them with right angles.

standards.title: Dollars and cents
standards.description: Recognise the relationships between dollars and cents and represent money values in different ways
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise relationships between dollars and cents and represent money values.

standards.title: Classify 3D objects
standards.description: Make, compare and classify objects, identifying key features and explaining why these features make them suited to their uses
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students make, compare and classify objects by key features and explain their suitability for uses.

standards.title: Create 2D representations
standards.description: Interpret and create two-dimensional representations of familiar environments, locating key landmarks and objects relative to each other
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students interpret and create 2D representations of familiar environments.

standards.title: Collect discrete numerical data
standards.description: Acquire data for categorical and discrete numerical variables to address a question of interest or purpose by observing, collecting and accessing data sets; record the data using appropriate methods including frequency tables and spreadsheets
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students collect categorical and discrete numerical data and record using frequency tables.

standards.title: Compare graphical representations
standards.description: Create and compare different graphical representations of data sets including using software where appropriate; interpret the data in terms of the context
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students create and compare graphical representations and interpret data in context.

standards.title: Conduct statistical investigations
standards.description: Conduct guided statistical investigations involving the collection, representation and interpretation of data for categorical and discrete numerical variables with respect to questions of interest
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students conduct guided statistical investigations involving collection, representation and interpretation of data.

standards.title: Likely and unlikely events
standards.description: Identify practical activities and everyday events involving chance; describe possible outcomes and events as 'likely' or 'unlikely' and identify some events as 'certain' or 'impossible' explaining reasoning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students describe outcomes as likely, unlikely, certain or impossible with reasoning.

standards.title: Conduct chance experiments
standards.description: Conduct repeated chance experiments; identify and describe possible outcomes, record the results, recognise and discuss the variation
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students conduct repeated chance experiments, record results and discuss variation.

standards.title: Decimals — tenths and hundredths
standards.description: Recognise and extend the application of place value to tenths and hundredths and use the conventions of decimal notation to name and represent decimals
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students extend place value to tenths and hundredths and use decimal notation.

standards.title: Odd and even numbers
standards.description: Explain and use the properties of odd and even numbers
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explain and use the properties of odd and even numbers.

standards.title: Equivalent fractions and decimals
standards.description: Find equivalent representations of fractions using related denominators and make connections between fractions and decimal notation
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students find equivalent fractions and connect fractions to decimal notation.

standards.title: Fractions on number lines
standards.description: Count by fractions including mixed numerals; locate and represent these fractions as numbers on number lines
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students count by fractions including mixed numerals and locate them on number lines.

standards.title: Multiply and divide by powers of 10
standards.description: Solve problems involving multiplying or dividing natural numbers by multiples and powers of 10 without a calculator, using the multiplicative relationship between the place value of digits
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students multiply and divide by multiples and powers of 10 using place value.

standards.title: Efficient addition and multiplication
standards.description: Develop efficient strategies and use appropriate digital tools for solving problems involving addition and subtraction, and multiplication and division where there is no remainder
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students develop efficient strategies for addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.

standards.title: Estimation and rounding
standards.description: Choose and use estimation and rounding to check and explain the reasonableness of calculations including the results of financial transactions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use estimation and rounding to check reasonableness including financial calculations.

standards.title: Model additive and multiplicative problems
standards.description: Use mathematical modelling to solve practical problems involving additive and multiplicative situations including financial contexts; formulate the problems using number sentences and choose efficient calculation strategies, using digital tools where appropriate; interpret and communicate solutions in terms of the situation
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use mathematical modelling to solve additive and multiplicative problems including financial contexts.

standards.title: Algorithms with addition and multiplication
standards.description: Follow and create algorithms involving a sequence of steps and decisions that use addition or multiplication to generate sets of numbers; identify and describe any emerging patterns
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students follow and create algorithms using addition or multiplication and identify patterns.

standards.title: Unknown values in equations
standards.description: Find unknown values in numerical equations involving addition and subtraction, using the properties of numbers and operations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students find unknown values in equations involving addition and subtraction.

standards.title: Multiplication facts to 10x10
standards.description: Recall and demonstrate proficiency with multiplication facts up to 10 x 10 and related division facts; extend and apply facts to develop efficient mental strategies for computation with larger numbers without a calculator
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recall multiplication facts to 10x10 and apply to develop efficient computation strategies.

standards.title: Measure with scaled instruments
standards.description: Interpret unmarked and partial units when measuring and comparing attributes of length, mass, capacity, duration and temperature, using scaled and digital instruments and appropriate units
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students interpret unmarked units on scaled instruments to measure length, mass, capacity, duration and temperature.

standards.title: Perimeter and area
standards.description: Recognise ways of measuring and approximating the perimeter and area of shapes and enclosed spaces, using appropriate formal and informal units
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students measure and approximate perimeter and area using formal and informal units.

standards.title: Duration with am and pm
standards.description: Solve problems involving the duration of time including situations involving 'am' and 'pm' and conversions between units of time
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students solve time duration problems including am/pm and conversions between units.

standards.title: Angle names
standards.description: Estimate and compare angles using angle names including acute, obtuse, straight angle, reflex and revolution, and recognise their relationship to a right angle
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students estimate and compare angles using acute, obtuse, straight, reflex and revolution names.

standards.title: Composite shapes
standards.description: Represent and approximate composite shapes and objects in the environment, using combinations of familiar shapes and objects
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students represent composite shapes using combinations of familiar shapes.

standards.title: Grid reference systems
standards.description: Create and interpret grid reference systems using grid references and directions to locate and describe positions and pathways
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students create and interpret grid reference systems to locate positions and pathways.

standards.title: Line and rotational symmetry
standards.description: Recognise line and rotational symmetry of shapes and create symmetrical patterns and pictures, using dynamic geometric software where appropriate
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise line and rotational symmetry and create symmetrical patterns.

standards.title: Many-to-one data displays
standards.description: Acquire data for categorical and discrete numerical variables to address a question of interest or purpose, using digital tools; represent data using many-to-one pictographs, column graphs and other displays or visualisations; interpret and discuss the information that has been created
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students acquire data and represent using many-to-one pictographs and column graphs.

standards.title: Analyse data distributions
standards.description: Analyse the effectiveness of different displays or visualisations in illustrating and comparing data distributions, then discuss the shape of distributions and the variation in the data
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse data displays and discuss the shape of distributions and data variation.

standards.title: Conduct statistical investigations
standards.description: Conduct statistical investigations, collecting data through survey responses and other methods; record and display data using digital tools; interpret the data and communicate the results
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students conduct statistical investigations, collect, display and interpret data.

standards.title: Order events by likelihood
standards.description: Describe possible everyday events and the possible outcomes of chance experiments and order outcomes or events based on their likelihood of occurring; identify independent or dependent events
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students describe outcomes of chance events and order them by likelihood, identifying independent and dependent events.

standards.title: Repeated chance experiments
standards.description: Conduct repeated chance experiments to observe relationships between outcomes; identify and describe the variation in results
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students conduct repeated chance experiments and describe variation in results.

standards.title: Decimals beyond hundredths
standards.description: Interpret, compare and order numbers with more than 2 decimal places, including numbers greater than one, using place value understanding; represent these on a number line
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students interpret, compare and order numbers with more than 2 decimal places.

standards.title: Factors and multiples
standards.description: Express natural numbers as products of their factors, recognise multiples and determine if one number is divisible by another
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students express numbers as products of factors and identify multiples and divisibility.

standards.title: Compare fractions with related denominators
standards.description: Compare and order fractions with the same and related denominators including mixed numerals, applying knowledge of factors and multiples; represent these fractions on a number line
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students compare and order fractions with related denominators including mixed numerals.

standards.title: Percentages, decimals and fractions
standards.description: Recognise that 100% represents the complete whole and use percentages to describe, represent and compare relative size; connect familiar percentages to their decimal and fraction equivalents
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use percentages and connect them to decimal and fraction equivalents.

standards.title: Add and subtract fractions
standards.description: Solve problems involving addition and subtraction of fractions with the same or related denominators, using different strategies
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students solve problems involving addition and subtraction of fractions with same or related denominators.

standards.title: Multiply larger numbers
standards.description: Solve problems involving multiplication of larger numbers by one- or two-digit numbers, choosing efficient calculation strategies and using digital tools where appropriate; check the reasonableness of answers
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students multiply larger numbers by one- or two-digit numbers using efficient strategies.

standards.title: Divide with remainders
standards.description: Solve problems involving division, choosing efficient strategies and using digital tools where appropriate; interpret any remainder according to the context and express results as a whole number, decimal or fraction
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students solve division problems and interpret remainders as whole numbers, decimals or fractions.

standards.title: Estimation strategies
standards.description: Check and explain the reasonableness of solutions to problems including financial contexts using estimation strategies appropriate to the context
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students check reasonableness of solutions including financial contexts using estimation.

standards.title: Model additive and multiplicative problems
standards.description: Use mathematical modelling to solve practical problems involving additive and multiplicative situations including financial contexts; formulate the problems, choosing operations and efficient calculation strategies, using digital tools where appropriate; interpret and communicate solutions in terms of the situation
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use mathematical modelling to solve additive and multiplicative problems including financial contexts.

standards.title: Algorithms for factors and divisibility
standards.description: Create and use algorithms involving a sequence of steps and decisions and digital tools to experiment with factors, multiples and divisibility; identify, interpret and describe emerging patterns
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students create algorithms to experiment with factors, multiples and divisibility.

standards.title: Multiplication and division as inverses
standards.description: Recognise and explain the connection between multiplication and division as inverse operations and use this to develop families of number facts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explain multiplication and division as inverses and develop families of number facts.

standards.title: Unknown values in multiplication equations
standards.description: Find unknown values in numerical equations involving multiplication and division using the properties of numbers and operations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students find unknown values in equations involving multiplication and division.

standards.title: Choose metric units
standards.description: Choose appropriate metric units when measuring the length, mass and capacity of objects; use smaller units or a combination of units to obtain a more accurate measure
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students choose appropriate metric units for length, mass and capacity measurements.

standards.title: Perimeter and area problems
standards.description: Solve practical problems involving the perimeter and area of regular and irregular shapes using appropriate metric units
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students solve perimeter and area problems for regular and irregular shapes.

standards.title: 12- and 24-hour time
standards.description: Compare 12- and 24-hour time systems and solve practical problems involving the conversion between them
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students compare 12- and 24-hour time and solve conversion problems.

standards.title: Measure angles with protractor
standards.description: Estimate, construct and measure angles in degrees, using appropriate tools including a protractor, and relate these measures to angle names
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students estimate, construct and measure angles in degrees using a protractor.

standards.title: Nets of objects
standards.description: Connect objects to their nets and build objects from their nets using spatial and geometric reasoning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students connect objects to their nets and build objects from nets.

standards.title: Grid coordinate system
standards.description: Construct a grid coordinate system that uses coordinates to locate positions within a space; use coordinates and directional language to describe position and movement
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students construct and use grid coordinate systems to describe position and movement.

standards.title: Transformations of shapes
standards.description: Describe and perform translations, reflections and rotations of shapes, using dynamic geometric software where appropriate; recognise what changes and what remains the same, and identify any symmetries
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students describe and perform translations, reflections and rotations identifying what changes and stays the same.

standards.title: Nominal and ordinal data
standards.description: Acquire, validate and represent data for nominal and ordinal categorical and discrete numerical variables, to address a question of interest or purpose using software including spreadsheets; discuss and report on data distributions in terms of highest frequency (mode) and shape, in the context of the data
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students acquire and represent nominal and ordinal data and report on distributions in terms of mode and shape.

standards.title: Interpret line graphs
standards.description: Interpret line graphs representing change over time; discuss the relationships that are represented and conclusions that can be made
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students interpret line graphs representing change over time and discuss relationships.

standards.title: Plan statistical investigations
standards.description: Plan and conduct statistical investigations by posing questions or identifying a problem and collecting relevant data; choose appropriate displays and interpret the data; communicate findings within the context of the investigation
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students plan and conduct statistical investigations, choose displays and communicate findings.

standards.title: Equally and unequally likely outcomes
standards.description: List the possible outcomes of chance experiments involving equally likely outcomes and compare to those which are not equally likely
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students list outcomes of chance experiments and compare equally and unequally likely outcomes.

standards.title: Estimate likelihoods from frequency
standards.description: Conduct repeated chance experiments including those with and without equally likely outcomes, observe and record the results; use frequency to compare outcomes and estimate their likelihoods
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students conduct repeated chance experiments and use frequency to estimate likelihoods.

standards.title: Integers and Cartesian plane
standards.description: Recognise situations, including financial contexts, that use integers; locate and represent integers on a number line and as coordinates on the Cartesian plane
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise integers in context and locate them on number lines and the Cartesian plane.

standards.title: Prime, composite and square numbers
standards.description: Identify and describe the properties of prime, composite and square numbers and use these properties to solve problems and simplify calculations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify prime, composite and square numbers and use their properties to solve problems.

standards.title: Compare and order fractions
standards.description: Apply knowledge of equivalence to compare, order and represent common fractions including halves, thirds and quarters on the same number line and justify their order
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students compare, order and represent common fractions on a number line using equivalence.

standards.title: Add and subtract decimals
standards.description: Apply knowledge of place value to add and subtract decimals, using digital tools where appropriate; use estimation and rounding to check the reasonableness of answers
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students add and subtract decimals using place value knowledge.

standards.title: Add and subtract fractions
standards.description: Solve problems involving addition and subtraction of fractions using knowledge of equivalent fractions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students solve problems involving addition and subtraction of fractions using equivalent fractions.

standards.title: Multiply and divide decimals
standards.description: Multiply and divide decimals by multiples of powers of 10 without a calculator, applying knowledge of place value and proficiency with multiplication facts; using estimation and rounding to check the reasonableness of answers
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students multiply and divide decimals by powers of 10 using place value knowledge.

standards.title: Fractions, decimals and percentages
standards.description: Solve problems that require finding a familiar fraction, decimal or percentage of a quantity, including percentage discounts, choosing efficient calculation strategies and using digital tools where appropriate
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students find fractions, decimals and percentages of quantities including percentage discounts.

standards.title: Approximate with rational numbers
standards.description: Approximate numerical solutions to problems involving rational numbers and percentages, including financial contexts, using appropriate estimation strategies
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students approximate solutions involving rational numbers and percentages using estimation.

standards.title: Model with rational numbers
standards.description: Use mathematical modelling to solve practical problems involving natural and rational numbers and percentages, including in financial contexts; formulate the problems, choosing operations and efficient calculation strategies, and using digital tools where appropriate; interpret and communicate solutions in terms of the situation, justifying the choices made
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use mathematical modelling to solve problems involving rational numbers and percentages.

standards.title: Growing patterns with rational numbers
standards.description: Recognise and use rules that generate visually growing patterns and number patterns involving rational numbers
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise and use rules that generate growing patterns involving rational numbers.

standards.title: Unknown values with brackets
standards.description: Find unknown values in numerical equations involving brackets and combinations of arithmetic operations, using the properties of numbers and operations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students find unknown values in equations involving brackets and combinations of operations.

standards.title: Algorithms for number patterns
standards.description: Create and use algorithms involving a sequence of steps and decisions that use rules to generate sets of numbers; identify, interpret and explain emerging patterns
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students create algorithms to generate number sets and explain emerging patterns.

standards.title: Convert metric units
standards.description: Convert between common metric units of length, mass and capacity; choose and use decimal representations of metric measurements relevant to the context of a problem
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students convert between metric units and use decimal representations.

standards.title: Area of rectangles
standards.description: Establish the formula for the area of a rectangle and use it to solve practical problems
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students establish and apply the formula for the area of a rectangle.

standards.title: Timetables and itineraries
standards.description: Interpret and use timetables and itineraries to plan activities and determine the duration of events and journeys
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students interpret and use timetables and itineraries to determine duration.

standards.title: Angle relationships
standards.description: Identify the relationships between angles on a straight line, angles at a point and vertically opposite angles; use these to determine unknown angles, communicating reasoning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify angle relationships on lines and at points and determine unknown angles.

standards.title: Cross-sections and prisms
standards.description: Compare the parallel cross-sections of objects and recognise their relationships to right prisms
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students compare parallel cross-sections and recognise their relationship to right prisms.

standards.title: Cartesian plane — 4 quadrants
standards.description: Locate points in the 4 quadrants of a Cartesian plane; describe changes to the coordinates when a point is moved to a different position in the plane
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students locate points in all 4 quadrants of a Cartesian plane and describe coordinate changes.

standards.title: Tessellations and transformations
standards.description: Recognise and use combinations of transformations to create tessellations and other geometric patterns, using dynamic geometric software where appropriate
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use combinations of transformations to create tessellations and geometric patterns.

standards.title: Compare distributions
standards.description: Interpret and compare data sets for ordinal and nominal categorical, discrete and continuous numerical variables using comparative displays or visualisations and digital tools; compare distributions in terms of mode, range and shape
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students interpret and compare distributions using mode, range and shape.

standards.title: Critique statistical arguments
standards.description: Identify statistically informed arguments presented in traditional and digital media; discuss and critique methods, data representations and conclusions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify and critique statistical arguments in media including methods and conclusions.

standards.title: Plan and refine investigations
standards.description: Plan and conduct statistical investigations by posing and refining questions or identifying a problem and collecting relevant data; analyse and interpret the data and communicate findings within the context of the investigation
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students plan and conduct statistical investigations, refining questions and communicating findings.

standards.title: Probability scale 0 to 1
standards.description: Recognise that probabilities lie on numerical scales of 0 – 1 or 0% – 100% and use estimation to assign probabilities that events occur in a given context, using common fractions, percentages and decimals
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students assign probabilities on a 0–1 scale using fractions, percentages and decimals.

standards.title: Simulations with increasing trials
standards.description: Conduct repeated chance experiments and run simulations with an increasing number of trials using digital tools; compare observations with expected results and discuss the effect on variation of increasing the number of trials
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students run simulations with increasing trials and discuss the effect on variation.

standards.title: Squares and square roots
standards.description: Describe the relationship between perfect square numbers and square roots, and use squares of numbers and square roots of perfect square numbers to solve problems
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students describe the relationship between perfect squares and square roots and solve problems.

standards.title: Prime factorisation
standards.description: Represent natural numbers as products of powers of prime numbers using exponent notation
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students represent natural numbers as products of prime powers using exponent notation.

standards.title: Expanded notation with powers of 10
standards.description: Represent natural numbers in expanded notation using place value and powers of 10
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students represent natural numbers in expanded notation using powers of 10.

standards.title: Rational numbers on a number line
standards.description: Find equivalent representations of rational numbers and represent rational numbers on a number line
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students find equivalent representations of rational numbers and place them on a number line.

standards.title: Round decimals appropriately
standards.description: Round decimals to a given accuracy appropriate to the context and use appropriate rounding and estimation to check the reasonableness of solutions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students round decimals to appropriate accuracy and use estimation to check solutions.

standards.title: Four operations with rational numbers
standards.description: Use the 4 operations with positive rational numbers including fractions, decimals and percentages to solve problems using efficient calculation strategies
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use four operations with fractions, decimals and percentages to solve problems.

standards.title: Add and subtract integers
standards.description: Compare, order and solve problems involving addition and subtraction of integers
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students compare, order and solve addition and subtraction problems with integers.

standards.title: Ratios
standards.description: Recognise, represent and solve problems involving ratios
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise, represent and solve problems involving ratios.

standards.title: Model with rational numbers
standards.description: Use mathematical modelling to solve practical problems, involving rational numbers and percentages, including financial contexts; formulate problems, choosing representations and efficient calculation strategies, using digital tools as appropriate; interpret and communicate solutions in terms of the situation, justifying choices made about the representation
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use mathematical modelling to solve practical problems involving rational numbers and percentages.

standards.title: Variables and formulas
standards.description: Recognise and use variables to represent everyday formulas algebraically and substitute values into formulas to determine an unknown
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use variables to represent formulas and substitute values to find unknowns.

standards.title: Algebraic expressions
standards.description: Formulate algebraic expressions using constants, variables, operations and brackets
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students formulate algebraic expressions using constants, variables, operations and brackets.

standards.title: Solve linear equations
standards.description: Solve one-variable linear equations with natural number solutions; verify the solution by substitution
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students solve one-variable linear equations with natural number solutions.

standards.title: Graphs of functions
standards.description: Describe relationships between variables represented in graphs of functions from authentic data
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students describe relationships between variables in graphs of functions from authentic data.

standards.title: Tables and graphs from patterns
standards.description: Generate tables of values from visually growing patterns or the rule of a function; describe and plot these relationships on the Cartesian plane
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students generate tables of values from patterns and plot relationships on the Cartesian plane.

standards.title: Manipulate formulas
standards.description: Manipulate formulas involving several variables using digital tools, and describe the effect of systematic variation in the values of the variables
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students manipulate multi-variable formulas and describe effects of systematic variation.

standards.title: Area of triangles and parallelograms
standards.description: Solve problems involving the area of triangles and parallelograms using established formulas and appropriate units
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students solve area problems for triangles and parallelograms using established formulas.

standards.title: Volume of right prisms
standards.description: Solve problems involving the volume of right prisms including rectangular and triangular prisms, using established formulas and appropriate units
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students solve volume problems for right prisms using established formulas.

standards.title: Pi and circles
standards.description: Describe the relationship between π and the features of circles including the circumference, radius and diameter
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students describe the relationship between π and circumference, radius and diameter.

standards.title: Angles with parallel lines
standards.description: Identify corresponding, alternate and co-interior relationships between angles formed when parallel lines are crossed by a transversal; use them to solve problems and explain reasons
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify and use corresponding, alternate and co-interior angle relationships.

standards.title: Angle sum of triangles
standards.description: Demonstrate that the interior angle sum of a triangle in the plane is 180° and apply this to determine the interior angle sum of other shapes and the size of unknown angles
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students demonstrate triangle angle sum is 180° and apply to find unknown angles.

standards.title: Model with ratios
standards.description: Use mathematical modelling to solve practical problems involving ratios; formulate problems, interpret and communicate solutions in terms of the situation, justifying choices made about the representation
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use mathematical modelling to solve practical ratio problems.

standards.title: Represent objects in 2D
standards.description: Represent objects in 2 dimensions; discuss and reason about the advantages and disadvantages of different representations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students represent objects in 2D and reason about advantages of different representations.

standards.title: Classify polygons
standards.description: Classify triangles, quadrilaterals and other polygons according to their side and angle properties; identify and reason about relationships
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students classify triangles, quadrilaterals and polygons by side and angle properties.

standards.title: Transformations on Cartesian plane
standards.description: Describe transformations of a set of points using coordinates in the Cartesian plane, translations and reflections on an axis, and rotations about a given point
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students describe transformations using coordinates including translations, reflections and rotations.

standards.title: Algorithms to classify shapes
standards.description: Design and create algorithms involving a sequence of steps and decisions that will sort and classify sets of shapes according to their attributes, and describe how the algorithms work
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students design algorithms to sort and classify shapes by attributes.

standards.title: Range, median, mean and mode
standards.description: Acquire data sets for discrete and continuous numerical variables and calculate the range, median, mean and mode; make and justify decisions about which measures of central tendency provide useful insights into the nature of the distribution of data
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students calculate range, median, mean and mode and justify which measure best describes a distribution.

standards.title: Stem-and-leaf plots
standards.description: Create different types of numerical data displays including stem-and-leaf plots using software where appropriate; describe and compare the distribution of data, commenting on the shape, centre and spread including outliers and determining the range, median, mean and mode
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students create numerical data displays including stem-and-leaf plots and describe distributions.

standards.title: Conduct numerical investigations
standards.description: Plan and conduct statistical investigations involving data for discrete and continuous numerical variables; analyse and interpret distributions of data and report findings in terms of shape and summary statistics
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students plan and conduct statistical investigations for numerical variables and report findings.

standards.title: Sample space and probability
standards.description: Identify the sample space for single-stage events; assign probabilities to the outcomes of these events and predict relative frequencies for related events
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify sample spaces and assign probabilities to single-stage events.

standards.title: Simulations with large trials
standards.description: Conduct repeated chance experiments and run simulations with a large number of trials using digital tools; compare predictions about outcomes with observed results, explaining the differences
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students run simulations with large trial numbers and compare predictions with observed results.

standards.title: Irrational numbers
standards.description: Recognise irrational numbers in applied contexts, including square roots and π
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise irrational numbers including square roots and π in applied contexts.

standards.title: Exponent laws
standards.description: Establish and apply the exponent laws with positive integer exponents and the zero-exponent, using exponent notation with numbers
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students establish and apply exponent laws including the zero exponent.

standards.title: Terminating and recurring decimals
standards.description: Recognise terminating and recurring decimals, using digital tools as appropriate
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise terminating and recurring decimals.

standards.title: Four operations with integers
standards.description: Use the 4 operations with integers and with rational numbers, choosing and using efficient strategies and digital tools where appropriate
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use four operations with integers and rational numbers efficiently.

standards.title: Model with rational numbers
standards.description: Use mathematical modelling to solve practical problems involving rational numbers and percentages, including financial contexts; formulate problems, choosing efficient calculation strategies and using digital tools where appropriate; interpret and communicate solutions in terms of the situation, reviewing the appropriateness of the model
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use mathematical modelling to solve practical problems with rational numbers and percentages.

standards.title: Simplify linear expressions
standards.description: Create, expand, factorise, rearrange and simplify linear expressions, applying the associative, commutative, identity, distributive and inverse properties
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students create, expand, factorise and simplify linear expressions using properties of operations.

standards.title: Graph and solve linear equations
standards.description: Graph linear relations on the Cartesian plane using digital tools where appropriate; solve linear equations and one-variable inequalities using graphical and algebraic techniques; verify solutions by substitution
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students graph linear relations and solve linear equations and inequalities algebraically and graphically.

standards.title: Model with linear functions
standards.description: Use mathematical modelling to solve applied problems involving linear relations, including financial contexts; formulate problems with linear functions, choosing a representation; interpret and communicate solutions in terms of the situation, reviewing the appropriateness of the model
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use mathematical modelling with linear functions to solve applied problems.

standards.title: Experiment with linear functions
standards.description: Experiment with linear functions and relations using digital tools, making and testing conjectures and generalising emerging patterns
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students experiment with linear functions, test conjectures and generalise patterns.

standards.title: Area of composite shapes
standards.description: Solve problems involving the area and perimeter of irregular and composite shapes using appropriate units
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students solve area and perimeter problems for irregular and composite shapes.

standards.title: Volume of right prisms
standards.description: Solve problems involving the volume and capacity of right prisms using appropriate units
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students solve volume and capacity problems for right prisms.

standards.title: Circumference and area of circles
standards.description: Solve problems involving the circumference and area of a circle using formulas and appropriate units
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students solve circumference and area problems for circles using formulas.

standards.title: Time across time zones
standards.description: Solve problems involving duration, including using 12- and 24-hour time across multiple time zones
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students solve time duration problems across multiple time zones.

standards.title: Rates
standards.description: Recognise and use rates to solve problems involving the comparison of 2 related quantities of different units of measure
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise and use rates to solve comparison problems.

standards.title: Pythagoras theorem
standards.description: Use Pythagoras' theorem to solve problems involving the side lengths of right-angled triangles
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use Pythagoras' theorem to solve right-angled triangle problems.

standards.title: Model with ratios and rates
standards.description: Use mathematical modelling to solve practical problems involving ratios and rates, including financial contexts; formulate problems; interpret and communicate solutions in terms of the situation, reviewing the appropriateness of the model
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use mathematical modelling to solve practical ratio and rate problems.

standards.title: Congruence and similarity
standards.description: Identify the conditions for congruence and similarity of triangles and explain the conditions for other sets of common shapes to be congruent or similar, including those formed by transformations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify conditions for congruence and similarity of triangles and other shapes.

standards.title: Properties of quadrilaterals
standards.description: Establish properties of quadrilaterals using congruent triangles and angle properties, and solve related problems explaining reasoning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students establish properties of quadrilaterals using congruent triangles and solve problems.

standards.title: 3D coordinate systems
standards.description: Describe the position and location of objects in 3 dimensions in different ways, including using a three-dimensional coordinate system with the use of dynamic geometric software and other digital tools
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students describe position and location in 3 dimensions using coordinate systems.

standards.title: Algorithms for congruency
standards.description: Design, create and test algorithms involving a sequence of steps and decisions that identify congruency or similarity of shapes, and describe how the algorithm works
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students design and test algorithms to identify congruency or similarity of shapes.

standards.title: Data collection techniques
standards.description: Investigate techniques for data collection including census, sampling, experiment and observation, and explain the practicalities and implications of obtaining data through these techniques
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate data collection techniques including census, sampling and experiment.

standards.title: Sampling and distribution
standards.description: Analyse and report on the distribution of data from primary and secondary sources using random and non-random sampling techniques to select and study samples
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse distributions using random and non-random sampling techniques.

standards.title: Sample size and variation
standards.description: Compare variations in distributions and proportions obtained from random samples of the same size drawn from a population and recognise the effect of sample size on this variation
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students compare variations across random samples and recognise the effect of sample size.

standards.title: Statistical investigations with samples
standards.description: Plan and conduct statistical investigations involving samples of a population; use ethical and fair methods to make inferences about the population and report findings, acknowledging uncertainty
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students conduct statistical investigations using samples and make inferences about populations.

standards.title: Complementary events
standards.description: Recognise that complementary events have a combined probability of one; use this relationship to calculate probabilities in applied contexts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise complementary events sum to 1 and use this to calculate probabilities.

standards.title: Two-way tables and tree diagrams
standards.description: Determine all possible combinations for 2 events, using two-way tables, tree diagrams and Venn diagrams, and use these to determine probabilities of specific outcomes in practical situations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students determine combinations for 2 events using tables, tree diagrams and Venn diagrams.

standards.title: Simulate compound events
standards.description: Conduct repeated chance experiments and simulations, using digital tools to determine probabilities for compound events, and describe results
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students simulate compound events and determine their probabilities.

standards.title: Real number system
standards.description: Recognise that the real number system includes the rational numbers and the irrational numbers, and solve problems involving real numbers using digital tools
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise the real number system including rational and irrational numbers and solve problems.

standards.title: Exponent laws with variables
standards.description: Apply the exponent laws to numerical expressions with integer exponents and extend to variables
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students apply exponent laws to numerical expressions and extend to variables.

standards.title: Quadratic expressions
standards.description: Simplify algebraic expressions, expand binomial products and factorise monic quadratic expressions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students expand binomial products and factorise monic quadratic expressions.

standards.title: Gradient, midpoint and distance
standards.description: Find the gradient of a line segment, the midpoint of the line interval and the distance between 2 distinct points on the Cartesian plane
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students find gradient, midpoint and distance between points on the Cartesian plane.

standards.title: Quadratic functions and equations
standards.description: Identify and graph quadratic functions, solve quadratic equations graphically and numerically, and solve monic quadratic equations with integer roots algebraically, using graphing software and digital tools as appropriate
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students graph quadratic functions and solve quadratic equations graphically and algebraically.

standards.title: Model with linear and quadratic
standards.description: Use mathematical modelling to solve applied problems involving change including financial contexts; formulate problems, choosing to use either linear or quadratic functions; interpret solutions in terms of the situation; evaluate the model and report methods and findings
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use mathematical modelling with linear or quadratic functions to solve applied problems.

standards.title: Experiment with functions
standards.description: Experiment with the effects of the variation of parameters on graphs of related functions, using digital tools, making connections between graphical and algebraic representations, and generalising emerging patterns
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students experiment with parameter variation on graphs and generalise emerging patterns.

standards.title: Surface area and volume
standards.description: Solve problems involving the volume and surface area of right prisms and cylinders using appropriate units
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students solve surface area and volume problems for right prisms and cylinders.

standards.title: Scientific notation
standards.description: Solve problems involving very small and very large measurements, time scales and intervals expressed in scientific notation
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students solve problems involving measurements and intervals expressed in scientific notation.

standards.title: Trigonometry in right triangles
standards.description: Solve spatial problems, applying angle properties, scale, similarity, Pythagoras' theorem and trigonometry in right-angled triangles
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students solve spatial problems applying trigonometry, Pythagoras' theorem, scale and similarity.

standards.title: Measurement error
standards.description: Calculate and interpret absolute, relative and percentage errors in measurements, recognising that all measurements are estimates
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students calculate and interpret absolute, relative and percentage measurement errors.

standards.title: Model with proportion and rates
standards.description: Use mathematical modelling to solve practical problems involving direct proportion, rates, ratio and scale, including financial contexts; formulate the problems and interpret solutions in terms of the situation; evaluate the model and report methods and findings
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use mathematical modelling to solve proportion, rate, ratio and scale problems.

standards.title: Trigonometric ratios
standards.description: Recognise the constancy of the sine, cosine and tangent ratios for a given angle in right-angled triangles using properties of similarity
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise sine, cosine and tangent as constant ratios for a given angle using similarity.

standards.title: Enlargement transformation
standards.description: Apply the enlargement transformation to shapes and objects using dynamic geometry software as appropriate; identify and explain aspects that remain the same and those that change
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students apply enlargement transformations and identify what changes and stays the same.

standards.title: Algorithms for geometric constructions
standards.description: Design, test and refine algorithms involving a sequence of steps and decisions based on geometric constructions and theorems; discuss and evaluate refinements
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students design, test and refine algorithms based on geometric constructions and theorems.

standards.title: Estimate population means
standards.description: Analyse reports of surveys in digital media and elsewhere for information on how data was obtained to estimate population means and medians
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse survey reports to estimate population means and medians.

standards.title: Sampling methods and bias
standards.description: Analyse how different sampling methods can affect the results of surveys and how choice of representation can be used to support a particular point of view
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse how sampling methods affect survey results and how representations can convey bias.

standards.title: Compare multiple distributions
standards.description: Represent the distribution of multiple data sets for numerical variables using comparative representations; compare data distributions with consideration of centre, spread and shape, and the effect of outliers on these measures
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students compare multiple distributions considering centre, spread, shape and outliers.

standards.title: Choose appropriate displays
standards.description: Choose appropriate forms of display or visualisation for a given type of data; justify selections and interpret displays for a given context
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students choose and justify appropriate data displays for given contexts.

standards.title: Statistical investigations
standards.description: Plan and conduct statistical investigations involving the collection and analysis of different kinds of data; report findings and discuss the strength of evidence to support any conclusions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students plan and conduct statistical investigations and discuss strength of evidence for conclusions.

standards.title: Compound event outcomes
standards.description: List all outcomes for compound events both with and without replacement, using lists, tree diagrams, tables or arrays; assign probabilities to outcomes
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students list outcomes for compound events with and without replacement and assign probabilities.

standards.title: Relative frequencies and compound events
standards.description: Calculate relative frequencies from given or collected data to estimate probabilities of events involving 'and', inclusive 'or' and exclusive 'or'
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students calculate relative frequencies to estimate probabilities of compound events using and/or logic.

standards.title: Simulate compound vs simple events
standards.description: Design and conduct repeated chance experiments and simulations, using digital tools to compare probabilities of simple events to related compound events, and describe results
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students design simulations comparing simple and compound event probabilities.

standards.title: Approximations in repeated calculations
standards.description: Recognise the effect of using approximations of real numbers in repeated calculations and compare the results when using exact representations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise how approximations of real numbers affect repeated calculations.

standards.title: Expand, factorise with exponent laws
standards.description: Expand, factorise and simplify expressions and solve equations algebraically, applying exponent laws involving products, quotients and powers of variables, and the distributive property
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students expand, factorise and simplify expressions applying exponent laws and the distributive property.

standards.title: Linear inequalities and simultaneous equations
standards.description: Solve linear inequalities and simultaneous linear equations in 2 variables; interpret solutions graphically and communicate solutions in terms of the situation
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students solve linear inequalities and simultaneous equations and interpret solutions graphically.

standards.title: Exponential functions
standards.description: Recognise the connection between algebraic and graphical representations of exponential relations and solve related exponential equations, using digital tools where appropriate
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students connect algebraic and graphical representations of exponential relations and solve exponential equations.

standards.title: Model growth and decay
standards.description: Use mathematical modelling to solve applied problems involving growth and decay, including financial contexts; formulate problems, choosing to apply linear, quadratic or exponential models; interpret solutions in terms of the situation; evaluate and modify models as necessary and report assumptions, methods and findings
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use mathematical modelling with linear, quadratic or exponential models to solve growth and decay problems.

standards.title: Experiment with functions
standards.description: Experiment with functions and relations using digital tools, making and testing conjectures and generalising emerging patterns
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students experiment with functions and relations, test conjectures and generalise patterns.

standards.title: Surface area and volume of composites
standards.description: Solve problems involving the surface area and volume of composite objects using appropriate units
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students solve surface area and volume problems for composite objects.

standards.title: Logarithmic scales
standards.description: Interpret and use logarithmic scales in applied contexts involving small and large quantities and change
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students interpret and use logarithmic scales in applied contexts.

standards.title: Trigonometry applications
standards.description: Solve practical problems applying Pythagoras' theorem and trigonometry of right-angled triangles, including problems involving direction and angles of elevation and depression
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students solve practical problems using trigonometry including elevation, depression and direction.

standards.title: Impact of measurement errors
standards.description: Identify the impact of measurement errors on the accuracy of results in practical contexts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify how measurement errors affect accuracy of results in practical contexts.

standards.title: Model proportion and scaling
standards.description: Use mathematical modelling to solve practical problems involving proportion and scaling of objects; formulate problems and interpret solutions in terms of the situation; evaluate and modify models as necessary, and report assumptions, methods and findings
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use mathematical modelling to solve proportion and scaling problems.

standards.title: Deductive reasoning and proofs
standards.description: Apply deductive reasoning to proofs involving shapes in the plane and use theorems to solve spatial problems
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students apply deductive reasoning to geometric proofs and use theorems to solve spatial problems.

standards.title: Network diagrams
standards.description: Interpret networks and network diagrams used to represent relationships in practical situations and describe connectedness
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students interpret network diagrams representing practical relationships and describe connectedness.

standards.title: Algorithms for spatial problems
standards.description: Design, test and refine solutions to spatial problems using algorithms and digital tools; communicate and justify solutions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students design, test and refine algorithmic solutions to spatial problems.

standards.title: Critique statistical reports
standards.description: Analyse claims, inferences and conclusions of statistical reports in the media, including ethical considerations and identification of potential sources of bias
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse statistical claims in media including ethical considerations and sources of bias.

standards.title: Boxplots and continuous distributions
standards.description: Compare data distributions for continuous numerical variables using appropriate data displays including boxplots; discuss the shapes of these distributions in terms of centre, spread, shape and outliers in the context of the data
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students compare continuous distributions using boxplots discussing centre, spread, shape and outliers.

standards.title: Scatterplots and association
standards.description: Construct scatterplots and comment on the association between the 2 numerical variables in terms of strength, direction and linearity
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students construct scatterplots and describe association in terms of strength, direction and linearity.

standards.title: Two-way tables
standards.description: Construct two-way tables and discuss possible relationship between categorical variables
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students construct two-way tables and discuss possible relationships between categorical variables.

standards.title: Bivariate statistical investigations
standards.description: Plan and conduct statistical investigations of situations that involve bivariate data; evaluate and report findings with consideration of limitations of any inferences
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students plan and conduct bivariate statistical investigations and evaluate the limitations of inferences.

standards.title: Conditional probability
standards.description: Use the language of 'if ... then', 'given', 'of', 'knowing that' to describe and interpret situations involving conditional probability
