standards.progression_checkpoint: Students describe and interpret situations involving conditional probability.

standards.title: Simulate conditional probability
standards.description: Design and conduct repeated chance experiments and simulations using digital tools to model conditional probability and interpret results
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students design simulations to model conditional probability and interpret results.

standards.title: Name and order numbers to 20
standards.description: Name, represent and order numbers including zero to at least 20, using physical and virtual materials and numerals
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students name, represent and order numbers including zero to at least 20.

standards.title: Subitise collections to 5
standards.description: Recognise and name the number of objects within a collection up to 5 using subitising
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise and name the number of objects in a collection up to 5 using subitising.

standards.title: Quantify and compare to 20
standards.description: Quantify and compare collections to at least 20 using counting and explain or demonstrate reasoning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students quantify and compare collections to at least 20 using counting.

standards.title: Part-part-whole to 10
standards.description: Partition and combine collections up to 10 using part-part-whole relationships and subitising to recognise and name the parts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students partition and combine collections up to 10 using part-part-whole relationships.

standards.title: Addition and subtraction situations
standards.description: Represent practical situations involving addition, subtraction and quantification with physical and virtual materials and use counting or subitising strategies
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students represent practical addition and subtraction situations using materials and counting strategies.

standards.title: Equal sharing and grouping
standards.description: Represent practical situations that involve equal sharing and grouping with physical and virtual materials and use counting or subitising strategies
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students represent practical situations involving equal sharing and grouping using materials.

standards.title: Copy and continue repeating patterns
standards.description: Recognise, copy and continue repeating patterns represented in different ways
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise, copy and continue repeating patterns.

standards.title: Compare attributes directly
standards.description: Identify and compare attributes of objects and events, including length, capacity, mass and duration, using direct comparisons and communicating reasoning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify and compare length, capacity, mass and duration using direct comparisons.

standards.title: Sequence days and times
standards.description: Sequence days of the week and times of the day including morning, lunchtime, afternoon and night time, and connect them to familiar events and actions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students sequence days of the week and times of day, connecting them to familiar events.

standards.title: Sort and name familiar shapes
standards.description: Sort, name and create familiar shapes; recognise and describe familiar shapes within objects in the environment, giving reasons
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students sort, name and create familiar shapes and recognise them in the environment.

standards.title: Describe position and location
standards.description: Describe the position and location of themselves and objects in relation to other people and objects within a familiar space
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students describe position and location of themselves and objects within a familiar space.

standards.title: Collect and sort data
standards.description: Collect, sort and compare data represented by objects and images in response to given investigative questions that relate to familiar situations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students collect, sort and compare data represented by objects and images.
